body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy that starts within 1 unit of you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy voluntarily begins moving away from you. Response: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage after its first unit of movement.

surges.html: On a hit, reduce its remaining Movement this turn by 1.
On a hit, follow 1 unit without triggering movement Reactions.
